text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm. Looks like some limescale
is starting to build up in the sink~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll do a quick tidy-up?
There's still time before training starts, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Cleaning your personal belongings while expressing your daily gratitude and love will give your luck a massive boost☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Thank you as always, Mr. Sink~♪
And Mr. Drain, you get squeaky clean too~♪

Copano Rickey didn't show up for training,
so while searching around for her—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr! I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I got so caught up in cleaning that I lost track of time...! I'm so sorry, I'll definitely give it my all tomorrow!

She seemed genuinely remorseful,
and cleaning is a good thing in itself, so
I simply told her to be mindful of the time.
